reading.title: Handling Supplies Safely
reading.text: During a workplace training session, adults practise handling light supplies safely. For small objects, a person may grab, hold, grip, clutch, and grasp. For boxes and packages, they may squeeze, clench, pinch, carry, and lift. When an item must move across a surface, they may push, pull, drag, shove, and tug. People choose the action that fits the object instead of using unnecessary force.

reading.title: Hand Actions Mini Story
reading.text: At the activity table, I use my hands in different ways. I yank, press, and twist. Then I turn and wring. I practice each action with safe classroom objects. We also remember earlier words such as grab and hold. The vocabulary is used in a realistic hand actions context that an adult could meet at home, at work, or in the community.
